silt__read answers the document a text spells, whichever way it is written. Text that opens the way a SILT line does is taken as SILT. A JSON scalar, the empty map and the empty list are read in the shell, and any other JSON goes through the translator. A JSON number such as 0.5 opens on digits and a dot as a SILT line does, and is still read as the number, since it holds no colon. Text that is none of these, the empty string and a bare word among them, fails without a message, because the caller decides what such text means.
